text:
courtney (marketplace PM): quick sync — we need a short playbook to get the aws/gcp/azure listings live. main blockers: credentials + metering integration, sku/pricing mapping, legal trial terms, and marketing assets. target: internal beta end of month. who can pick up which piece?

alex k: i can own IAM/roles and the publisher account setup for aws and azure. will need the exact permission set. @rahul can you confirm the service endpoints we need?

rahul (eng): for metering we need three things: (1) publisher credentials + account ids, (2) sample usage event payloads, (3) a webhook endpoint for async receipts. prefer to reuse our existing billing webhook: https://billing.redwood.internal/marketplace-metering

rahul (eng): sample minimal metering payload (we'll adjust per vendor):
```
{
  "productCode": "RW-INFER-STD",
  "usageDimension": "tokens_generated",
  "quantity": 12345,
  "timestamp": 1670000000,
  "customerId": "acct-123"
}
```

nina p: i'll assemble publisher account info and upload branding assets (logo 256x256, hero png, short description). also will request publisher portal invites for the partner. will share a drive link in a bit.

samir (legal): can draft a short marketplace EULA addendum + trial term language. need sku names + trial length + whether coupons are allowed. also confirm whether we're permitting self-service upgrades via the cloud portals.

alex k: SKU plan proposal: 
- rw-basic (14d trial, usage capped)
- rw-standard (monthly, metered tokens)
- rw-enterprise (annual commit + seat/throughput tiers)
I'll post a JSON sku->pricing mapping to #docs after this thread.

courtney (marketplace PM): thanks. action items so far: 
- alex: IAM roles + sku mapping (owns)
- rahul: metering payload schema & webhook readiness (owns)
- nina: branding + publisher invites + sample account ids (owns)
- samir: eula/trial text (owns)
I'll schedule a 30m kickoff tomorrow. 

listings-bot: [system] created marketplace-onboarding checklist for thread 4340001111 — add items as you complete them :white_check_mark:

alex k: quick note on permissions — for aws we need: `aws-marketplace:MeterUsage`, `aws-marketplace:RegisterUsage`, and STS assume-role to the publisher account. will paste policy snippet shortly.

rahul (eng): one risk to flag: if partner traffic surges, our metering events could lag and cause billing mismatches. suggest we add a 5% buffer and an alert for high-lag windows.

courtney (marketplace PM): good catch. rahul, please add an alert runbook entry. nina, when you post publisher ids, mark any sandbox vs prod flags.

nina p: uploading assets now — drive link: https://drive.redwood.com/marketplace/onboard/4340001111 (contains logos, 1-pager, screenshots).

samir (legal): drafted trial clause — short summary: 14-day trial auto-converts unless canceled, billing begins on conversion date. will attach the full wording in #legal-review later.

courtney (marketplace PM): awesome. i'll send calendar invite for tomorrow 9:30am PT and include the checklist + links. if anyone cannot make it, drop async notes here. :rocket:
